name: night-shift-review
description: Night Shift bounded balance repeat: up to 6 attempts. Each attempt the fenced showdown-balancer agent edits one number on one troop card inside a scratch snapshot; a separate reviewer step runs scripts/contest-balance.mjs review, which checks the one-field diff, runs the property tests and plays a paired tune range and a disjoint holdout range at the base commit. The loop stops when .artifacts/contest-balance/status.json has pass true. Never applies a candidate, edits real cards, merges or opens PRs; Fable/Alex decide. The single-finding flow stays available as node scripts/night-review.mjs run.

steps.prompt:
Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs reset
Report its exit status and printed lines exactly. It archives any earlier .artifacts/contest-balance run (it deletes nothing) and writes status.json with pass false. Edit no file yourself.

Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs prepare
Report its exit status and printed lines exactly. Exit status 2 means no attempt could be prepared; report the reason and stop. Edit no file yourself and never touch .kiro/specs/duel-card-pipeline/cards/.

Prepare result:
{{previous.output}}
If no attempt was prepared, report that and stop. Otherwise follow your agent instructions for the highest-numbered attempt: read its brief.json and edit exactly one number on one whitelisted troop card inside that attempt's scratch snapshot only.
When the edit is done, report it with send_message to sessionId "parent" only, a short text message and severity "success". The fence allows no other destination.

Balancer report:
{{previous.output}}
You are the reviewer and did not write this candidate. Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs review
It diffs the scratch snapshot against the base commit (exactly one whitelisted troop card file, exactly one whitelisted field, nothing else), rebuilds the candidate in a fresh snapshot, runs the Showdown property tests on baseline and candidate, plays the tune and holdout seed ranges from both seats with the level-2 bot, and writes the sealed receipt and status.json. Report the exit status and printed lines exactly, then read the attempt's receipt.json and report: the change, violations, property results, Cowboy, Wizard, draw and first-seat shares before and after for tune and holdout, paired flips, the per-card cohort status counts (measured, sparse, unmeasured) and the verdict with every reason. Exit 0 is PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 unusable. PASS means only 'measured match shares are in the band; ready for Fable/Alex review'. It is not a claim that any single card is balanced. Do not change the verdict, edit files, apply the change, push, merge or open an issue or PR.
Step completion: exit 0 (PASS) and exit 1 (FAIL) with a sealed receipt.json are both successful completions of this review step. An ordinary policy FAIL is a valid review result, not a step error: report it with send_message to sessionId "parent" and severity "success" so the step completes, the repeat reads status.json pass false and the next attempt runs. Use severity "error" only when the review is unusable: exit 2, a missing or unsealed receipt, or a command that could not run. Only that terminates the run.

Run exactly once from the project root: node scripts/contest-balance.mjs verify
It checks the latest receipt's seal, the stored game records, the recomputed decision, the scratch card hash and status.json. Report its exit status and output exactly, how many attempts ran (the attempt number in .artifacts/contest-balance/status.json) and whether status pass is true. State that the run surface was the local CLI and that no candidate was applied to the real cards. Edit nothing.
